## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should preserve the existing 12-character revision identifier so deployments remain distinguishable across status, history, and completion output.

## Changes
The pull request adds running deployment output with a shortened revision and attempt number, plus tests for the status format and attempt labels. This review assessed tests by reading them without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history identifier in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, running status displays `0123456`, while history displays `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but `revision[:7]` differs from history’s `revision[:12]` at `app/display.py:5`. — Deployments sharing seven leading revision characters become indistinguishable while running, even when history and completion distinguish them.
